idea.title: Peppa's muddy-puddle corner
idea.description: Blue mats, puddle cut-outs and rain boots for photos, like Peppa's favourite game.

items.rationale: A six-year-old Peppa Pig fan will love jumping in muddy puddles.

idea.title: Cartoon tattoo stall
idea.description: Temporary cartoon tattoos applied by a parent volunteer while kids wait for cake.

items.rationale: Quick for 25 kids and fits the cartoon theme.

idea.title: Peppa story-time circle
idea.description: A short read-aloud of a Peppa Pig story before the cake, with cushions on the floor.

items.rationale: Calms the room before the cake for six-year-olds.
